home_prompt: Use case ui-mockup. Original Japanese website homepage proposal for 自転車館びーくる, 山口県防府市 sports bicycle specialist. Exact1536x864 16:9 canvas. Large desktop website left, narrow mobile website right. White, deep navy, orange accent, clean Japanese typography. Text-only store name, no copied logo. Headline「自転車のある毎日へ。」Original illustrative photograph of unbranded sports bicycle outdoors; no actual stock or shop implied. Category cards「ロードレーサー」「クロスバイク」「小径車・折りたたみ」. Prominent pale-orange purchase notice panel with text wrapping within desktop and mobile:「ご購入前にご確認ください」「在庫状況はリアルタイムではありません。店頭・メーカー在庫の確認後にお取引成立となります。」 Button「ご利用ガイド」 and「お問い合わせ」. MAIN IMPROVEMENT narrow screen purchase notices vertically arranged with readable line wrapping no horizontal clipping. No prices, availability promises, reviews or invented benefits. Visible「非公式デザイン案」「写真はイメージです」. Mobile purchase notice prominently readable. Beautiful professional finished web design.
inquiry_prompt: Create separate inquiry guidance webpage design for 自転車館びーくる using attached homepage as visual style reference. 1536x864 16:9 landscape, desktop left and mobile right.
